result.summary: Project gtrfwde schedule contains 22 activities and has a recorded progress of 32.0%. A Daily Construction Report indicates progress on 'Formworks first floor slab' matching the schedule's 60% completion. However, the date on the report (10.03.2017) contradicts the schedule's actual start dates (September 2017). Additionally, the schedule failed a logic quality check.

schedule_findings.finding: Missing logic - 3 of 22 activities (13.6%) have no predecessor or successor.

issues.description: Schedule dates contradict field evidence: DCR 218 is dated 10.03.2017 and reports 60% progress on the first floor slab, but the schedule records the actual start for this activity (P218-STR-Z3-060) as 2017-09-27.

review_questions.question: Does the report date '10.03.2017' refer to March 10 or October 3? Both interpretations conflict with the schedule dates (e.g. actual start 2017-09-27) or the day of the week ('Sun'). Please verify the report date and schedule alignment.
